findings.fact: Witness is git log --all --max-count=1 for each filename. The selected artifact records no common compilation source snapshot/blobs, dirty-source snapshot, compiler/options/include/define recipe, or preserved backup reference.
findings.implication: A historical filename witness alone does not independently prove reconstruction of the exact historical compiled artifact. It does not establish that unique dirty-source behavior or inputs were preserved.
findings.source_owner_next: For further releases, retain or supply the existing qualifying rebuild/backup evidence required by the scratch contract; keep ambiguous/unique artifacts HOLD. Existing history/path witnesses remain useful inventory evidence.

findings.fact: The live-path os.unlink occurs before the UNLINKED journal entry; no per-file INTENT is fsynced first and no containing directory fsync is performed.
findings.implication: A crash between unlink and journal append can leave a released path without a per-file intent/outcome record.
findings.source_owner_next: Reuse the proven V9 intent-before-unlink, parent identity/fsync and DONE journaling sequence with a read-only reconcile path; do not blindly retry an interrupted real selector.
